channel.title: Frontion — World Headlines
channel.description: Curated geopolitical headlines from Tier 1 sources worldwide

item.title: Iran Claims Control of Strait of Hormuz, Says It Is Not Seeking Talks After US Bombing Halt
item.description: 🇮🇷🛢️ Iran stated it still controls the strategic Strait of Hormuz and is not seeking new negotiations with the US, despite Trump pausing 13 consecutive nights of strikes to allow diplomatic space. The standoff leaves global oil shipping routes in limbo.

item.title: Deadly Van Attack Near Berlin Pride Festival Raises Security Questions
item.description: 🇩🇪⛪ A woman was killed and at least 16 injured when a van rammed into a crowd near Berlin's Pride festival. Germany's interior minister called it a suspected Islamic extremist terror attack. Questions are mounting over why the suspect had been released from custody.

item.title: Saudi Arabia Intercepts Iranian-Backed Militia Drones Targeting Oil Facilities
item.description: 🇸🇦💥 Saudi air defenses intercepted and destroyed several drones launched from Iraq by Iran-backed militias targeting the kingdom's petroleum facilities. Saudi Arabia condemned the attacks and reserved the right to respond, as regional tensions escalate alongside the US-Iran conflict.

item.title: Oil Prices Plunge 7% as US-Iran Pause Strikes for Diplomacy
item.description: 💰🛢️ Brent crude fell below $90 a barrel and US crude dropped to around $83 — both down roughly 7% — after the US and Iran paused their escalating strikes to allow room for diplomacy. Global stock markets rallied on hopes the conflict could de-escalate.

item.title: Wildfires Force Mass Evacuations Across France and Spain as Fire Clouds Form
item.description: 🇫🇷🇪🇸🔥 More than 250,000 people have been evacuated in southwestern France as wildfires approach Bordeaux, while Spain battles blazes near Madrid and Castellón. Pyrocumulonimbus clouds — fire-generated thunderstorms — are intensifying the fires, with King Felipe VI visiting evacuation centers.

item.title: UK selects Tekever AR5 surveillance drones to replace Watchkeeper fleet
item.description: 🇬🇧 The UK Ministry of Defence has chosen Portuguese-made Tekever AR5 drones to succeed the troubled Watchkeeper program, marking a shift toward lighter, more flexible ISR capabilities for the British Army.

item.title: Indonesia central bank governor Warjiyo resigns as rupiah hits record lows
item.description: 🇮🇩 Bank Indonesia Governor Perry Warjiyo stepped down before his term expires, following mounting criticism over the rupiah's plunge to record lows and accelerating capital flight from Southeast Asia's largest economy.

item.title: Mediators report progress on diplomatic opening to de-escalate US-Iran conflict
item.description: 🕊️ Qatar and Pakistan-led mediation efforts have made progress toward resuming US-Iran negotiations, with regional officials saying both sides appear open to a diplomatic off-ramp after 13 nights of strikes.

item.title: US criticism of Malaysia Israel ban spotlights growing diplomatic disconnect
item.description: 🇲🇾 US accusations that Malaysia's ban on Israelis entering the country is antisemitic are unlikely to change policy but underscore widening diplomatic rifts between Washington and Muslim-majority Southeast Asian nations.

item.title: Marcos pushes tax exemptions and power reforms to revive Philippine growth
item.description: 🇵🇭 Philippine President Marcos Jr. used his penultimate State of the Nation Address to propose raising income tax thresholds and energy reforms, aiming to stimulate an economy hit by the global oil crisis.

item.title: Oil prices plunge over 9% as US-Iran pause raises de-escalation hopes
item.description: 🛢️📉 Brent crude fell below $88 a barrel after the US halted attacks on Iran for a second consecutive night and Iran paused retaliatory strikes, sparking market optimism about a diplomatic resolution to the conflict.

item.title: Iran warns Ukraine of retaliation after deadly Caspian Sea strike on vessel
item.description: 🇮🇷🇺🇦⚔️ Iran Foreign Minister Araghchi said a Ukrainian attack on an Iranian commercial vessel in the Caspian Sea that killed one sailor cannot go unanswered, accusing Israel of provoking the strike to drag Europe into a wider conflict.

item.title: US appeals court upholds halt to Trump executive order creating federal voter list
item.description: 🇺🇸🏛️ A federal appeals court upheld a lower court ruling blocking Trump's order to create a federal citizenship list for voters and restrict mail ballot delivery, rejecting the administration's effort to implement it ahead of the November midterms.

item.title: Ukrainian startup Fire Point mass-producing cruise missiles, striking deep into Russia
item.description: 🇺🇦🚀 The Guardian reports Fire Point is manufacturing 100 Flamingo cruise missiles monthly and hundreds of drones daily, enabling Ukraine to sustain deep-strike operations inside Russia and closing the gap on Russian long-range attack capabilities.

item.title: Argentina Milei calls Brazil Lula a thief and convict at Bolsonaro campaign rally
item.description: 🇦🇷🇧🇷 Argentina president Javier Milei insulted Brazilian president Lula da Silva at a rally for Flavio Bolsonaro in Sao Paulo, prompting Brazil to recall its ambassador and escalating a diplomatic crisis between South America two largest economies.

item.title: US Congress approves $500M for Taiwan defense as Trump continues hesitating on arms package
item.description: 🇺🇸🇹🇼🇨🇳 The US House passed a bill including $500 million in Foreign Military Financing for Taiwan, signaling Congressional support even as President Trump withholds approval of a $14 billion weapons package after meeting Xi Jinping. Analysts say the allocation demonstrates Congress values Taiwan defense against Chinese expansion.

item.title: Ukraine and US coordinate new peace push, hoping Russia accepts air truce
item.description: 🇺🇦🇺🇸🕊️ Ukraine and the US are aligning on a new round of peace proposals to present to Moscow, with a US official saying the White House believes the Kremlin may now be more willing to accept at least a partial air ceasefire as Ukraine expands strikes inside Russia.

item.title: Ukrainian drones strike export terminal and oil facilities in latest deep strike on Russia
item.description: 🇺🇦🛩️⛽ Ukrainian drones hit an export terminal in Rostov-on-Don on the Black Sea and oil facilities in Udmurtia and Yaroslavl Oblast, over 1,300 km from Ukrainian territory. Two people were killed and five injured in the Rostov attack, the governor reported.

item.title: Britain’s new PM Burnham to host Zelensky as first foreign leader visit since taking office
item.description: 🇬🇧🇺🇦🏛️ New UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham will welcome Volodymyr Zelensky to London, making the Ukrainian president the first foreign leader to visit since Burnham replaced Keir Starmer. Zelensky is set to visit a British naval base and discuss continued defense support for Ukraine.

item.title: Israeli ex-army chief Eisenkot emerges as main rival to Netanyahu ahead of October election
item.description: 🇮🇱🗳️⚔️ Former military chief Gadi Eisenkot has surged as the principal challenger to Benjamin Netanyahu ahead of Israel’s October 27 general election. A Channel 12 poll puts his new Yashar party at 23 seats versus Likud’s 22, in what is widely seen as a referendum on Netanyahu’s leadership.

item.title: US and Iran pause strikes for third night as diplomatic efforts intensify
item.description: 🇺🇸🇮🇷🕊️ The US military has paused airstrikes on Iran for a third consecutive night, with the UN ambassador saying Trump is giving talks space. Iran halted retaliatory attacks in response. Oil prices fell below $90 per barrel after hitting $100 last week. Oman-mediated technical talks on the Strait of Hormuz are progressing.

item.title: Shein swings to $99m loss as Trump tariffs and Iran war hit sales
item.description: 💰📉🇨🇳 The fast-fashion giant posted a $99m first-quarter loss versus $395m profit a year earlier, as the removal of the US de minimis tariff exemption and the Iran war disrupted deliveries and demand. Shein also reported the Iran conflict increased costs and caused shipping delays across multiple markets.

item.title: Diplomatic off-ramp elusive as US-Iran war nears five months
item.description: 🕊️🛢️⚔️ NPR analysis: After 13 consecutive nights of US strikes on Iran, a pause has opened diplomatic space but both sides remain far apart on Strait of Hormuz control. Iran and Oman held technical talks in Tehran over the weekend. Trump says he is not in a hurry despite midterm pressure over gas prices. Netanyahu visits the White House on Tuesday.

item.title: Fire clouds threaten to worsen Europe wildfire crisis as new heatwave looms
item.description: 🔥☁️🇫🇷🇪🇸 Pyrocumulonimbus clouds, fire-generated thunderstorms that can create lightning and unpredictable winds, have been observed for the first time in France as wildfires ravage the country and Spain. Experts warn another heatwave with temperatures up to 40C could hit France from Tuesday, threatening to intensify the crisis that has already forced 330,000 evacuations.

item.title: Mali's separatist-al-Qaeda alliance reshapes Sahel conflict
item.description: 🇲🇱⚔️🌍 An unprecedented military partnership between the Azawad Liberation Front and al-Qaeda affiliate JNIM has transformed northern Mali conflict, with coordinated offensives challenging both the Malian army and Russia Africa Corps. The alliance poses the most serious battlefield threat to Bamako in years and has far-reaching implications for Sahel security.
